# Archived GitHub Actions workflows

These workflows are retained as provenance for the completed formal direct-access bibliographic-frame build.

They were moved out of `.github/workflows/` because their triggers are tied to the historical branch `analysis/formal-biblio-openalex-fetch-v1` and they are not part of routine CI or manuscript reproduction.

The YAML is preserved unchanged under this directory. Moving a workflow here disables GitHub Actions registration without deleting the historical procedure.

Archived in this batch: 40 workflows.
